plain: A formal charge of a serious crime, often issued by a grand jury

webster.text: A written accusation or formal charge of a crime or misdemeanor, preferred by a grand jury under oath to a court.

more.text: The paper or parchment containing the accusation of a grand jury.

example.quote: But the party convicted shall, nevertheless be liable and subject to indictment, trial, judgment and punishment according to law.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 6, 1787
